shortDescription: Create SSL CSR files on the BIG-IP.

options.name: challenge_password
options.description: Specifies the C(PKCS#9) challenge-password with which to associate this CSR.

options.name: city
options.description: Specifies the x509 city with which to associate this CSR.

options.name: country
options.description: Specifies the 2 letter x509 country code with which to associate this CSR.

options.name: dest
options.description: The destination on your local filesystem to use for saving the CSR file.

options.name: email_address
options.description: Specifies the x509 email-address used to create the certificate signing request.

options.name: key_name
options.description: The SSL key used to generate the CSR.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the CSR file.

options.name: organization
options.description: Specifies the x509 organization name with which to associate this CSR.

options.name: ou
options.description: Specifies the x509 organizational unit used to create the certificate signing request.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition on which to manage resources.

options.name: province
options.description: Specifies the x509 state or province used to create the certificate signing request.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures that the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures that the resource does not exist.

options.name: subject_alternative_name
options.description: The Subject Alternative Name of the certificate.
